description: --add-section in update.ts ignored --body: addSectionBody declared but never assigned by the arg parser
resolution: Added name=body shorthand and --body lookahead to --add-section parsing, mirroring --section in create.ts. Removed stale sectionBody fallback. Wired --body through commander registration.

name: section-arg-parsing
description: CLI arg parsing for section flags: use indexOf('=') for name=body shorthand detection and lookahead (args[i+1] === '--body') for the two-flag form. Both create.ts --section and update.ts --add-section/--section follow this pattern. When adding new section-like flags, always implement both forms.

content: Commander registration must mirror raw arg parsing: when a flag accepts --body, the .action() handler must also forward opts.body to the args array. See update.ts lines 231-238 where --section and --add-section both conditionally push --body.

name: repeatable-section-flags
description: Repeatable section flags in update.ts: convert single addSectionName/addSectionBody vars to addSections[]{name,body} array; convert removeSectionName to removeSections[]. Parsing loop pushes into arrays (same lookahead for --body). Mutation loops over arrays. Commander registration uses accumulator (v,a)=>a.concat([v]) matching --tag pattern. .action() iterates arrays to rebuild args.

name: remove-section-splice-pattern
description: --remove-section behavior: for non-inheriting prompts (no extends field), splice the section from the array entirely. For inheriting prompts (has extends), use body='' to suppress the inherited section during render. This avoids noise entries in the JSONL store.
.gitattributes check in init.ts used includes('merge=union') which is too broad: if seeds/mulch already added merge=union entries for their own JSONL files, canopy entries were silently skipped.
resolution: Check for canopy-specific path (.canopy/prompts.jsonl) instead of generic merge=union string. Added test to verify entries are appended even when other tools' merge=union lines exist.

name: multi-issue-lead-falloff
description: Leads dispatched with multiple issues (different files) may only complete the primary sling issue and exit. For best coverage, dispatch one lead per issue or accept that a second lead may be needed for remaining issues.

name: brand-palette-output
description: Brand palette constants in output.ts: export palette.brand (chalk.rgb(56,142,60) deep green), palette.accent (chalk.rgb(255,183,77) amber for IDs), palette.muted (chalk.rgb(120,120,110) stone gray for metadata). Legacy c helpers delegate to palette where applicable (green→brand, yellow→accent).

name: style-a-help-screen
description: Style A help screen pattern for Commander CLI: override formatHelp via configureHelp(), check cmd.parent to delegate subcommand help to Commander default, iterate cmd.commands dynamically for command list, use palette.brand(chalk.bold) for tool name, palette.muted for version, chalk.green for command names, chalk.dim for args/flags, 18-char field with 2-space min gap for column alignment.

name: palette-chalk-instance-style
description: palette in output.ts should use direct chalk instances (chalk.rgb(56,142,60)) not arrow function wrappers. Instances support chaining (palette.brand.bold(...)); arrow functions do not. All fmt helpers in output.ts rely on this.

name: visual-branding-dispatch
description: Visual branding overhaul dispatch pattern: palette (output.ts) must merge first since downstream tasks (icons, messages, highlighting) depend on palette constants. Phase 1: single lead for palette. Phase 2: parallel leads — one for help screen (index.ts), one for all command file changes (icons+messages+highlighting combined to avoid file area overlap).
Icons builder branch forked before palette merge caused merge conflict in output.ts (arrow functions vs chalk instances). Auto-merge-resolve failed.
resolution: Dispatch a merge-fix lead to reimplement changes on updated main. Prevention: when Phase 2 leads depend on Phase 1 merges to shared files, ensure Phase 2 worktrees are created AFTER the Phase 1 merge.

name: cli-standards-alignment
description: CLI standards alignment: quiet flag (module-level _quiet + setQuiet + gate humanOut), verbose flag (declare-only), --version --json rich metadata (rawArgs before Commander), doctor command (8 checks: config, prompts-integrity, schemas-integrity, schema-validation, inheritance, emit-staleness, stale-locks, version-sync), upgrade command (npm registry fetch + bun install -g). Doctor reads VERSION by parsing index.ts source to avoid side-effect imports from index.ts.

name: update-command-test-pattern
description: update.ts integration test pattern: 22 tests covering section add/remove/replace (--section --body, name=body shorthand, --add-section), tag mutations (--tag/--untag, repeatable), metadata updates (--name, --description, --schema, --extends, --emit-as, --status), version bump, JSON output, and ExitError on missing prompt. Use same tmpDir/captureOutput/beforeEach pattern as create.test.ts with tmpDir='.test-tmp-update'.

name: sync-test-git-repo-pattern
description: sync.test.ts integration test pattern: use real git repos (git init in /tmp/cn-test-... path outside any existing repo) rather than mocking Bun.spawnSync. Initialize with git config user.email/name + initial commit on .canopy/. Tests cover: clean state, successful commit, date in commit message, --status human+json, --json flag, ExitError on non-git dir.

name: store-lock-concurrency-test-pattern
description: Lock concurrency testing pattern for store.ts: use Promise.all with 5 concurrent acquire/sleep/write/release sequences to verify serialization; backdate lock mtime by 31s (>LOCK_STALE_MS=30000ms) via node:fs/promises utimes to test stale cleanup; create fresh lock file and race acquireLock with 6s setTimeout to verify LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS=5000ms throws /timeout/i.

name: list-test-archived-pattern
description: list.test.ts integration test pattern: use update() to set archived status (create only supports draft|active). Test archived exclusion by creating a prompt then updating it to archived via update(['name', '--status', 'archived'], false).

name: archive-test-pattern
description: archive.test.ts pattern: use tmpDir = join(import.meta.dir, '../../.test-tmp-<cmd>'), captureOutput helper, beforeEach init + chdir, afterEach rmSync. Import archive, create, init, update from commands. Tests: happy path, JSON output, not-found error, already-archived error, JSONL state verification via readJsonl+dedupById, and unarchive via update --status active.

name: array-at-for-typecheck
description: Use Array.prototype.at(0) and at(-1) instead of index access [0]/[length-1] in TypeScript test assertions — avoids 'undefined' assignability errors in strict mode when biome forbids non-null assertions.

name: capture-output-throw-pattern
description: When testing CLI commands that call jsonOut then throw ExitError, captureOutput helper loses stdout (it re-throws without returning). Use inline console.log capture + finally restore to recover JSON written before the throw.

name: show-test-pattern
description: show.test.ts pattern: tests for cn show cover name lookup, --json output (parsed JSON assertions), name@version pinned-version lookup, nonexistent prompt/version (ExitError), section body display in human output, description/tags display, missing name arg error. Follow create.test.ts structure exactly: captureOutput helper, tmpDir per file, chdir in try/finally.

tree.ts renderChildren and buildTree functions lack cycle detection: cycles in prompt inheritance cause stack overflow in both human and JSON output modes. The ancestor traversal has a guard (ancestors.includes check) but the child-rendering functions do not.
resolution: Add a 'visited' Set parameter to renderChildren and buildTree to skip already-seen prompt names.

name: test-batch-parallelization
description: Test coverage batch: 9 independent test files dispatched as 3 leads x 3 builders for maximum parallelization. All test files are disjoint (each writes to a unique .test.ts), enabling conflict-free parallel merges. Total: 186 tests across 21 files.

name: frontmatter-render-merge
description: When adding frontmatter to RenderResult (required field), resolveInner must return prompt.frontmatter ?? {} for base case and { ...parentResult.frontmatter, ...(prompt.frontmatter ?? {}) } for inherited case — child overrides parent keys.

name: frontmatter-parser-pattern
description: frontmatter.ts YAML subset parser: uses recursive parseMappingBlock/parseSequenceBlock functions with indent tracking. extractFrontmatter splits on --- delimiters, renderFrontmatter uses serializeValue. Handles scalars, quoted strings, sequences of scalars and objects (continuation fields at baseIndent+2), nested mappings. needsQuoting guards true/false/null/numeric strings to avoid round-trip type loss.

name: render-frontmatter-merge
description: Frontmatter merging in render.ts: RenderResult includes frontmatter: Record<string, unknown>. resolveInner returns prompt.frontmatter ?? {} for no-parent case; shallow-merges { ...parentResult.frontmatter, ...(prompt.frontmatter ?? {}) } for extends case. Child keys override parent. mergeFrontmatter helper wraps the spread.

name: fm-flag-pattern
description: Frontmatter flag pattern for cn create/update: use --fm key=value (repeatable) to set frontmatter fields and --remove-fm key (repeatable) in update to delete them. Raw arg loop uses indexOf('=') for key=value detection, same as section-arg-parsing pattern. Commander registration uses accumulator callbacks.

name: import-fm-integration
description: import-fm integration: extractFrontmatter called before splitMarkdown; metadata.description maps to prompt.description; remaining keys (excluding name/description) stored in prompt.frontmatter; worktree must include frontmatter.ts and types.ts frontmatter field when dependency branches not yet merged

name: emit-frontmatter-pattern
description: emit.ts promptToMarkdown pattern: rename sectionsToMarkdown to promptToMarkdown, accept frontmatter+name+description params, build combined frontmatter {name, description?, ...userKeys}, call renderFrontmatter, prepend to sections with blank line separator. All three call sites (emitPrompt, checkMode, single-emit) must be updated consistently.

name: display-frontmatter-commands
description: cn show displays frontmatter key/value pairs after pinned field (humanOut loop over Object.entries); cn render includes frontmatter in both JSON output (frontmatter field) and markdown format (YAML-style --- block before sections). RenderResult.frontmatter is Record<string,unknown> initialized with ?? {} for base prompts and merged with spread for extending prompts.

name: frontmatter-epic-merge-order
description: When merging 7 parallel builder branches that share prerequisite changes (types.ts, render.ts), merge foundation branches first (types, parser, render engine) then fan-out branches. Auto-resolve handles duplicate prerequisite additions. Dead helper function left by auto-resolve is cosmetic — inline spread is functionally correct.

title: Named emit targets replace emitDir/emitDirByTag
rationale: Flat config mixed concerns — emitDir was the default and emitDirByTag was an inverted index. Named targets make each destination self-documenting with dir, optional default flag, and optional tag list. Backward compat preserved via transparent conversion in loadConfig().

name: Recursive YAML parser
description: YAML parser (src/yaml.ts) supports multi-level nested maps and array values (- item syntax) via recursive parseBlock/parseArray. YamlValue type: string | string[] | YamlMap (interface, not type alias, to avoid TS circular reference error). serializeValue handles indent levels recursively.

content: resolveEmitDir priority order: (1) prompt.emitDir per-prompt override, (2) first target with a matching tag, (3) target marked default: true, (4) hardcoded 'agents' fallback. This is in src/commands/emit.ts.

name: idempotent-template-literal-escaping
description: escapeTemplateLiteral uses a single-pass regex to handle both raw and pre-escaped template literal sequences. Already-escaped sequences (backslash-backtick, double-backslash, backslash-dollar) are preserved as-is; raw backticks, dollar-brace, and lone backslashes are escaped. This makes the function idempotent — safe for content with markdown-escaped backticks.

A three-step replace chain (escape backslashes, then backticks, then dollar-brace) double-escapes content that already has backslash-backtick pairs. The first step doubles the existing backslash, then the second step adds another before the backtick, producing triple-backslash-backtick instead of single.
resolution: Replaced with a single-pass regex using alternation that recognizes already-escaped sequences and preserves them, while still escaping raw characters.

name: quiet-flag-full-wiring
description: Complete quiet flag pattern for Canopy CLI: (1) output.ts exports isQuiet() and gates jsonOut to suppress success envelopes (errors pass through), (2) index.ts moves setQuiet() before version/json early-exit and uses jsonOut() instead of console.log for --version --json output, (3) commands with raw process.stdout.write (prime, onboard --stdout, completions) gate writes with !isQuiet(). humanOut() was already gated.

content: quiet flag wiring: commands must import humanOut from output.ts and use it instead of console.log for all human-readable messages; console.log bypasses the _quiet gate. upgrade.ts and doctor.ts both had this issue. completions/prime use process.stdout.write for their primary content output (not human messages) so they are exempt.

name: quiet-flag-dispatch
description: Single-issue quiet flag (--quiet/-q) was implemented as 2 builder tasks: (1) core wiring in output.ts/index.ts adding isQuiet() and gating jsonOut/humanOut, (2) console.log to humanOut cleanup in doctor.ts/upgrade.ts. Merge order matters: core infrastructure first, then consumer cleanup.

name: config-legacy-format-migration
description: Config format evolution: canopy supports both legacy (emitDir/emitDirByTag) and new (targets) config formats. Legacy format auto-converts to targets on load via parseYaml in config.ts:36-76. Conversion inverts tag→dir mapping to dir→tags named targets. Format is implicitly upgraded to new format on next cn sync write. No migration script needed — transparent backward compatibility.

name: v1done-audit-rewrite
description: V1_DONE.md audit-driven refinement: scouts generate spec with items-to-add + open questions; builders do full rewrite replacing flat checklist with granular per-feature checklists, infrastructure notes section, and expanded out-of-scope list. Only documentation modified — no code changes.

name: mulch-prompt-schema
description: Prompt type extension for warren mulch meshing (canopy-3ba6, plan pl-003f step 1): added optional MulchBlock { prime?: { domains?: string[]; files?: string[] }, budget?: number, on_empty?: 'skip'|'warn'|'error' } and top-level extends_mulch?: boolean to Prompt. Field names use snake_case (extends_mulch, on_empty) to match the on-disk frontmatter spec, deliberately diverging from canopy's camelCase TS convention. JSONL store needs no changes — JSON.stringify omits undefined keys, so absent fields stay absent on disk and legacy records read back with the new fields as undefined.

name: mulch-extends-merge-semantics
description: Implemented extends_mulch merge semantics in resolveInner (canopy-400c, plan pl-003f step 2). RenderResult gained optional mulch?: MulchBlock; field is omitted (not null/empty) when no role declares mulch. Semantics: extends_mulch=true unions prime.domains/files (deduped, parent-first order) and last-wins budget/on_empty across parent + each mixin's resolved mulch + focal.mulch; extends_mulch=false (default) means focal.mulch wholesale overrides — no inheritance from parent OR mixins. Multi-level inheritance applies pairwise: each level's flag controls its own merge with its parent, so a middle layer without extends_mulch breaks the chain. mergeMulch helper guards prime sub-object construction (only allocate when at least one of domains/files exists) so absent stays absent through every code path. Mixin merge semantics deliberately tied to focal's flag (per plan alternative #5) — defer real per-mixin extends_mulch to follow-up.

name: render-json-mulch-envelope
description: cn render --json envelope: surface resolved mulch as a top-level field. Build envelope as Record<string, unknown>, then conditionally assign mulch only when result.mulch !== undefined — never null, never {}. Apply identically to --format json (sans success/command). Keeps absent-vs-empty distinction (canopy-f027, plan pl-003f step 3).

name: mulch-shape-validation
description: Schema-shape validation for the mulch block + extends_mulch flag (canopy-e74d, plan pl-003f step 4): added validateMulch(prompt) in src/validate.ts that checks unknown keys at mulch.* and mulch.prime.*, on_empty enum (skip|warn|error), domains/files string-array typing, non-negative finite budget, and extends_mulch boolean type. Wired into validatePrompt so cn validate surfaces mulch errors, and added a checkMulchShape doctor check that runs over all non-archived prompts with a mulch or extends_mulch field. Validation errors carry section paths like 'mulch.prime.domains' for clear diagnostics.

name: mulch-domains-doctor-check
description: Optional doctor check (canopy-552d, plan pl-003f step 5): cn doctor adds a 'mulch-domains' check that reads .mulch/mulch.config.yaml from cwd, parses 'domains' via parseYaml, and warns (status: warn, never fail) when any active prompt's resolved mulch.prime.domains references a domain not declared in the mulch config. Degrades to a pass/no-op when .mulch/mulch.config.yaml is absent. Every result message labels the consulted config path (relative '.mulch/mulch.config.yaml') so multi-repo setups can disambiguate. Wired into both initial run() sequence and the post-fix re-check sequence.

name: mulch-spec-docs
description: Documented the mulch block + extends_mulch flag in SPEC.md (new 'Mulch Metadata' section: schema, override-vs-merge semantics, no-shell-out invariant, render envelope shape, doctor check, validation errors). Also updated cn prime full content and bumped onboard snippet to v2 with a Mulch Metadata blurb so AI agents discovering canopy via CLAUDE.md learn about the new fields. Onboard version bump required updating onboard.test.ts assertions (v:1 → v:2).

name: warren-smoke-subprocess-test
description: End-to-end warren-style smoke test (canopy-594a, plan pl-003f step 7): src/commands/render.smoke.test.ts spawns the cn CLI as a subprocess via Bun.spawn(['bun', cnEntry, ...]) — unlike render.test.ts which calls renderCmd directly — to verify the full warren consumption contract: stable JSON envelope shape (success/command/name/version/sections/resolvedFrom/frontmatter/mulch), absent-vs-empty mulch field invariant, multi-level extends_mulch chain merging, and the no-shell-out invariant via a PATH-prefixed 'ml' tracer shim that asserts no marker file is written. Use a per-test tmpDir + .canopy/config.yaml + appendJsonl seeding pattern; pipe stdout/stderr via Bun.spawn streams. Format primeArgs construction inline (biome line-length tolerance) when asserting array equality.

name: show-displays-mixins
description: cn show displays the Mixins field (joined by ', ') beneath Extends in human output when prompt.mixins is non-empty. The JSON path already surfaces it since the whole prompt object is dumped. Test coverage in show.test.ts asserts both 'Extends: <parent>' and 'Mixins: <m1, m2>' lines when create() is called with --extends and --mixin together.

name: mixins-multi-inheritance
description: Multi-inheritance via mixins (canopy-2ef1): extends + mixins compose left-to-right: parent chain → mixin1 → mixin2 → ... → focal, later wins on section-name conflicts. Frontmatter shallow-merges with same precedence. Surface area touched: types.ts (mixins?: string[]), render.ts (resolveInner mixin loop), create.ts (--mixin flag, repeatable), update.ts (--mixin/--remove-mixin), list.ts (--mixin filter), tree.ts (mixin label + descendants), doctor.ts inheritance check, show.ts (Mixins line). SPEC.md has a dedicated 'Mixins (Multi-Parent Composition)' subsection under Composition Model. Mulch metadata follows the same chain when extends_mulch=true.

name: canopy-config-schema-canonical-only
description: src/config-schema.ts exports configSchema() returning a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for .canopy/config.yaml. Mirrors sd config-schema.ts but covers only the canonical shape: project, version, and targets (Record<name, EmitTarget> with dir/default/tags). Legacy emitDir/emitDirByTag fields are intentionally absent — loadConfig migrates them on read; first cn config set normalizes the file. The schema acts as warren V2's wire contract (R-10): warren reads cn config schema --json, renders a form, writes back via cn config set. Schema is locked by src/config-schema.test.ts golden tests asserting top-level shape (required: project+version, additionalProperties: false), property key sets, EmitTarget defs, and the targets.$ref linkage.

name: yaml-parse-scalar-or-flow
description: src/yaml.ts: parseScalarOrFlow(s) returns typed YamlScalar (string|number|boolean|null|array|map) from a single CLI scalar/flow string. Used by cn config set to turn an arg into a typed value before schema-validating the write. Adds YamlScalar as a NEW union type alongside existing string-only YamlMap/YamlValue rather than widening them — keeps parseYaml/serializeYaml callers (config.yaml round-trips) unchanged. Lifted from seeds/src/yaml.ts (parseScalarOrFlow + parseFlowSeq/parseFlowMap + splitFlow + findFlowKeyColon helpers); single-quote escapes use doubled-apostrophe ('' → ').

title: Add ajv as canopy runtime dependency
rationale: ajv joins chalk + commander as the third runtime dep, breaking the long-standing 'chalk + commander only' invariant in canopy/CLAUDE.md. Justified because (1) ajv is required for cn config schema/set to validate writes against the canonical config-schema.ts JSON Schema, (2) mulch already ships ajv so marginal install cost is near-zero for ecosystem users, (3) hand-rolling AJV-equivalent error formatting + schema-path traversal would be significant untested code, (4) parity with mulch/seeds config CLIs is the wire contract warren V2 expects. Pinned to ^8.17.1 to match mulch.

name: canopy-config-command
description: src/commands/config.ts mirrors sd config (schema/show/set/unset subcommands) for warren V2's wire contract. Reads via parseYaml + a narrow toTypedView coercer (string "true"/"false" → boolean only at targets.<name>.default — canopy's parseYaml is string-only). Validates via AJV with the $schema URI stripped (draft 2020-12 advertised, AJV runs default mode). Writes through a typed→YamlMap conversion (booleans stringify to "true"/"false" matching saveConfig's existing convention). Lock acquired on config.yaml; inner try/finally releases it; errors throw plain Error then re-throw ExitError to preserve the finally per mx-301cd1.

name: config-command-wiring
description: Wired registerConfigCommand into src/index.ts following index-wiring-pattern (mx-f949d3): dynamic import grouped with schema/validate (config is the next-gen config surface alongside cn schema/validate), then registered in the same order. Command appears in cn --help and 'cn config --help' lists schema/show/set/unset subcommands.

name: cn-config-test-pattern
description: cn config integration tests (src/commands/config.test.ts) use subprocess pattern (Bun.spawn ['bun','run',CLI,...]) with NO_COLOR=1, modeled after seeds/src/commands/config.test.ts: mkdtemp per test, run cn init first, then exercise schema/show/set/unset via stdout/stderr/exitCode assertions. Lock + atomic-write invariants asserted by listing .canopy/ after failures (no .lock or .tmp.* files). Concurrent writes tested via Promise.all of 5 disjoint targets, asserting all succeed and final config validates against AJV-compiled configSchema() (after stripping $schema URI for draft-07 strict:false compile).

name: canopy-config-docs
description: Documented cn config in SPEC.md (new 'Config Management' section with schema/show/set/unset usage, JSON envelope examples, atomic-rename + post-write validation invariant, legacy normalize-on-first-write note), README.md (new 'Config' subsection in commands table + standalone Config section mirroring seeds), CLAUDE.md (runtime-deps line updated chalk+commander+ajv), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased entries for the command and the ajv dependency). Mirror seeds' README structure for the Config section so warren consumers see the same shape across cn/sd/ml.
